attribution.title: Nantes - fontaine de la Place Royale
attribution.author:
This photo was taken by Eusebius (Guillaume Piolle).
Feel free to reuse it, but always credit me as the author as specified below.
attribution.description: Fountain of the Place Royale in Nantes. It shows allegorical figures of Nantes (top), of the Loire river (front) and of its tributaries: the Erdre (front left), the Sèvre nantaise (front right), the Cher (right, hidden) and the Loiret (left, hidden). Architect of the place: Mathurin Crucy (1788). Fountain by Daniel Ducommun de Locle, Guillaume Grootaërs and Simon Voruz (1865).
